Mie scattering width of a two-dimensional dielectric cylinder Evolve the actual two-dimensional scattered fields and compare closed-contour Poynting power with an independent cylindrical series. Methods, equations, figures and references Assumptions, units and boundaries Use c = epsilon0 = mu0 = 1, an infinite cylinder with Ez polarization, radius 0.25, relative permittivity 2.25 and vacuum wavelength 1. The 6 × 6 domain has four-side PML and an explicitly nodal staircase geometry. Editorial clarification This is a lossless two-dimensional Ez cylinder, not a three-dimensional sphere. Report staircase geometry error without claiming general second-order curved-boundary accuracy or precision scattering for arbitrary frequencies and materials. The central white region is a diagnostic mask at r<0.4, distinct from the physical cylinder radius0.25. Adopted numerical method Advance the scattered Yee fields with an exact discrete incident difference on the polarization-contrast support.
